newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-FAI Cup quarter final fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-FAI Cup quarter final fixtures.

text.p: Football Association of Ireland (FAI) senior challenge Cup quarter-final fixtures. All kick-off times given in GMT.
Bohemians versus St.Patrick's Athletic at Dalymount Park, 1930 GMT.
Waterford United versus Drogheda United at Waterford Regional Sports Centre, 1945 GMT.
Bray Wanderers versus Shelbourne at Carlisle Grounds, 1515 GMT.
Derry City versus Cork City at The Brandywell, 1500 GMT.
